from tomlkit import aot
from tomlkit import dumps
from tomlkit import parse
from tomlkit import table


def test_issue_542_aot_captures_too_many_keys() -> None:
    doc = parse("a.b = 1\nc.d = 2\n")
    aot_obj = aot()
    t = table()
    t["x"] = 9
    aot_obj.append(t)
    doc["a"] = aot_obj
    # The bug causes 'c.d = 2' to be incorrectly captured within the AOT 'a'.
    # The expected output should have 'c.d = 2' outside of 'a'.
    expected_dump = "a.b = 1\n[[a]]\nx = 9\n\nc.d = 2\n"
    assert dumps(doc) == expected_dump
